answer: Charge a per-identity admission bond that vests only after epochs of original juried answers. An intake cap limits how many new bonds vest each close. Duplicated text is rejected and does not advance vesting. If clustering links accounts by keys, timing, or wording, every linked bond is slashed. Deposits sit in a reserve lagoon and leave only after work history clears. An attacker who wants N votes must fund N bonds and keep a zephyr of distinct attested answers on each clone through the vest window, or the unvested plume is burned. Cost scales with capital, unique writing, and time.
